meta.name: imap-smtp-email
meta.description: Read and send email via IMAP/SMTP. Check for new/unread messages, fetch content, search mailboxes, mark as read/unread, and send emails with attachments. Works with any IMAP/SMTP server including Gmail, Outlook, 163.com, vip.163.com, 126.com, vip.126.com, 188.com, and vip.188.com.

copy.tagline: 通过 IMAP/SMTP 收发邮件并管理收件箱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码或自动化工具收发邮件
copy.tagline_en: Read and send emails via IMAP/SMTP, manage your inbox
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive emails programmatically

howto.what: Claude 可以读取、搜索和管理你的邮件，还能发送带附件的邮件。
howto.when: 当你要求查看新邮件、搜索邮件、标记已读/未读或发送邮件时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下收件箱里有没有新邮件。
say.note: Claude 会检查并列出未读邮件。

say.text: 搜索来自张三的邮件，主题包含“会议”。
say.note: Claude 会按条件搜索邮件。

say.text: 给李四发一封邮件，主题是“你好”，正文是“测试”。
say.note: Claude 会通过 SMTP 发送邮件。

howto.what_en: Claude can read, search, and manage your emails, and send emails with attachments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to check new emails, search emails, mark as read/unread, or send emails.

say_en.text: Check my inbox for new emails.
say_en.note: Claude will check and list unread emails.

say_en.text: Search emails from John with subject containing 'meeting'.
say_en.note: Claude will search emails by criteria.

say_en.text: Send an email to Jane with subject 'Hello' and body 'Test'.
say_en.note: Claude will send the email via SMTP.
